text: These Aave and Morpho products quote higher rates than a short-term Treasury fund. But fees and access to your money matter.
Over ninety days, Aave earns eleven dollars more than the Treasury fund after fees, if rates hold.
Aave version three had about sixty-five hundred USDC available in April. Today's figures don't guarantee immediate withdrawals.
Fees can erase the extra earnings. Apps should explain costs and withdrawal delays.
